description: Captures each Claude Code session into the local sessionator history. PreCompact runs asynchronously and cuts an incremental summary segment before context is compacted; SessionEnd cuts the final segment when the session finishes. Both pipe the hook payload to `sessionator ingest --hook`, which spools it and detaches a worker, so neither blocks. Silent no-op when the sessionator CLI is not installed, and opt-out per project via .claude/sessionator.local.md. Never touches Codex or ~/.codex configuration.
